jobs.title: Jr. Application Development Engineer
jobs.description:
Ben jij klaar om impact te maken in een snel veranderende wereld? Wil jij bijdragen aan de volgende generatie logistieke oplossingen? Solliciteer dan nu!

Een startpremie van € 1.000 bruto wanneer je vóór 1 december 2026 jouw arbeidsovereenkomst ondertekent;

Innovatie wordt steeds belangrijker in een wereld die continu verandert. Bij Ewals Cargo Care
streven we ernaar om het verschil te maken in de dynamische logistieke markt. Onze ambitie is om voorop te blijven lopen door middel van onderscheidende en innovatieve oplossingen. We zoeken voortdurend naar slimme manieren om uitdagingen aan te pakken, processen te verbeteren en nieuwe kansen te benutten.

Als Junior Application Development Engineer
werk je mee aan de interne ontwikkeling van applicaties die de kernprocessen van Ewals Cargo Care ondersteunen en verbeteren.

De startdatum voor deze rol is voor 1 December 2026 of na 18 januari 2027!

Hoe maak jij impact?

Wij zoeken een Junior Application Development Engineer die eigenaarschap neemt over zijn of haar werk en trots is op wat wordt opgeleverd. We waarderen professionals die begrijpen welke oplossingen zij ontwikkelen, verantwoordelijkheid nemen voor de kwaliteit ervan en open communiceren over zowel hun expertise als hun ontwikkelpunten.

In deze rol werk je mee aan de ontwikkeling van innovatieve digitale oplossingen die processen binnen de gehele organisatie ondersteunen en verbeteren. Samen met collega's uit verschillende disciplines analyseer je kansen, ontwerp en ontwikkel je Minimum Viable Products (MVP's) en help je deze succesvol naar productie te brengen.

Zo werken we komend jaar onder andere aan een portal voor klanten en leveranciers, een applicatie voor onze procurement organisatie en de verdere doorontwikkeling van onze oplossing voor de commerciële organisatie op het gebied van contractmanagement, tendermanagement, budgettering en forecasting. Daarnaast speelt het team een belangrijke rol in het verder ontwikkelen en productierijp maken van proof-of-concepts die door het Innovation Team zijn ontwikkeld.

Je krijgt de kans om organisatiebreed samen te werken en ervaring op te doen in alle fasen van de softwareontwikkelcyclus: van het analyseren van businessvraagstukken en het ontwerpen van oplossingen tot het ontwikkelen, testen, implementeren en beheren van applicaties in productie.

Wat ga je doen?

Ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van nieuwe applicaties en processen, of bestaande oplossingen continu verbeteren.
Intensief samenwerken met stakeholders die functionele requirements vaststellen.
Samen met het developmentteam het volledige ontwikkeltraject beheren.
Demonstraties verzorgen van opgeleverde oplossingen om de effectiviteit ervan te evalueren met stakeholders.
Werken binnen een Scrum-team.
Full-stack softwareontwikkeling uitvoeren.

Wie zoeken we?

Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in Software Engineering, Informatica, IT, Technology of een vergelijkbare richting.
0 tot 3 jaar werkervaring.
Uitstekende beheersing van de Engelse taal, Nederlands is een pre.
Affiniteit met de Scrum-methodiek.
Ervaring met of sterke interesse in programmeertalen zoals C#
, TypeScript
en SQL
.
Bij voorkeur ervaring met React
voor het ontwikkelen van gebruikersinterfaces.
Bij voorkeur ervaring met microservice-architecturen
en Kubernetes
.
Bij voorkeur ervaring met Microsoft Azure
-diensten, zoals Web Apps, Managed Storage en Azure SQL Databases.
Interesse in en begrip van de ontwikkelingen, toepassingen en impact van Artificial Intelligence (AI)
.
Een hands-on mentaliteit die past bij onze bedrijfscultuur.
Creatief denkvermogen en het vermogen om technische uitdagingen vanuit verschillende perspectieven te benaderen.
Sterke samenwerkingsvaardigheden in een dynamische en snel veranderende omgeving.
Een echte passie voor applicatieontwikkeling
en de ambitie om impact te maken.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Ewals Cargo Care krijg je de kans om je carrière te starten binnen een innovatieve internationale logistieke organisatie. Je werkt met moderne technologieën, draagt bij aan de digitalisering van onze processen en krijgt volop ruimte om jezelf zowel technisch als persoonlijk verder te ontwikkelen. Samen bouwen we aan slimme oplossingen die de toekomst van logistiek vormgeven.
Een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur.
Hybride werken, na je onboarding kun je 2-3 dagen thuis werken! We faciliteren je thuiswerkplek.
Marktconform salaris met 8% vakantiegeld en 1000 euro startpremie!
Een tijdelijk contract dat bij goed functioneren wordt omgezet naar vast.
Pensioenregeling met slechts 5% eigen bijdrage.
28 vakantiedagen + mogelijkheid om 10 extra dagen bij te kopen.
Reiskostenvergoeding, gezondheidschecks, fietsplan en meer.
Toegang tot opleidingen via de Ewals Academy en doorgroeimogelijkheden

Over Ewals Cargo Care

We geloven in een betere en betekenisvolle supply chain voor iedereen. Dat realiseren we door samen met onze partners en leveranciers slimme en duurzame communities te bouwen. We bieden betrouwbare oplossingen om de cargo van onze klanten te vervoeren. We care, connect, move.
Bij Ewals Cargo Care, met 2.550 medewerkers in 13 landen, zijn we meer dan een logistiek bedrijf, we zijn een familie die naar elkaar omkijkt. Met meer dan een eeuw aan ervaring zijn we uitgegroeid tot een grote internationale speler, maar onze roots als familiebedrijf vormen nog steeds de basis van alles wat we doen. Wat ons écht definieert, is niet de naam op het gebouw, maar de manier waarop we elkaar elke dag steunen, zien en bijstaan. We geloven in mensen, en we investeren in hun groei met oprechte aandacht en zorg. Zelfs wanneer het tempo hoog ligt, verliezen we nooit uit het oog waar we kunnen helpen of aanmoedigen.
We werken vanuit vertrouwen, gaan uit van goede intenties en zoeken steeds de balans tussen ambitie en realisme. Onze cultuur is informeel, open en energiek , waar communicatie gemakkelijk verloopt en iedereen benaderbaar is, ongeacht rol of functie. We zijn er trots op dat we anders zijn dan andere logistieke bedrijven, en precies die trots drijft ons om te blijven groeien en vernieuwen. Via programma’s zoals ons Young Professional Program en de Ewals Academy helpen we onze mensen hun toekomst vorm te geven.

We care, we connect, we move — samen. Dat is de geest die ons al generaties lang draagt en die ons blijft leiden terwijl we de toekomst met optimisme en veerkracht omarmen.

Please note:
We are currently unable to offer visa sponsorship
.
We are not a recognized sponsor with the IND (Dutch Immigration and Naturalisation Service)
.
This means we cannot hire candidates who require sponsorship
, including those on a Highly Skilled Migrant (HSM) visa
or those seeking employment under a "zoekjaar" (orientation year) visa
.
Acquisition is not allowed. If you send any CV we might consider them as direct applicants and continue the process without agency involvement.

Let's Connect!

Is deze functie echt iets voor jou? Dan wordt het tijd dat we je ontmoeten! Neem gerust contact op met onze Talent Acquisition Manager Simen Sturme of solliciteer direct via de link.

jobs.title: Microsoft/Azure Stack Engineer Consultant
jobs.description:
AI & Tech

Breadcrumb

Home >
Microsoft/Azure Stack Engineer Consultant

Microsoft/Azure Stack Engineer Consultant

Amstelplein, Amsterdam, Netherlands

I'm interested

Share this job

Company Description

Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. 

With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

Job Description

The role

We are looking for a Microsoft/Azure Stack Engineer to join our Data Science & AI team as a consultant. This is a client-facing role first: most of your time is spent on client engagements, designing and building Azure infrastructure and platform solutions, advising on cloud strategy, and representing Sia's technical delivery capability directly to the client. Alongside that, you will get hands-on with AI on the side of the business: building demos and proofs of concept on Azure AI Foundry that support new client opportunities, rather than running or maintaining an internal platform. If you want client exposure plus a genuine way to build AI skills on top of your infrastructure expertise, this is a team where that combination is real.

What You Will Do

Work directly with client teams and stakeholders as a consultant, explaining technical trade-offs and architecture decisions in plain language.
Design and implement Azure infrastructure, including networking, compute, storage, and identity components (Azure AD/Entra ID, VNets, App Services, AKS).
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to support infrastructure-as-code deployments (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates).
Manage and optimize Microsoft 365 and Azure governance, including security baselines, cost management, and compliance controls.
Build demos and proofs of concept on Azure AI Foundry to support business development and potential client work.
Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues across hybrid and cloud-native environments.
Advise clients on cloud migration strategy, landing zone design, and the Azure Well-Architected Framework.
Collaborate with client IT teams, architects, and Sia consultants to deliver technical roadmaps and implementation plans.
Document architecture decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures.
Depending on seniority, mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal capability building within the Azure and AI practice.

Qualifications

What you bring

Comfortable working directly with clients as a consultant, and able to explain technical trade-offs in plain language.
Willing and able to travel for client work (mostly within the Benelux).
3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure in a production environment.
Strong knowledge of Azure core services: compute, networking, storage, identity, and security.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates).
Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD tooling.
Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and Entra ID/Azure AD.
Scripting proficiency in PowerShell, Python, or similar.
Interest in or experience with Azure AI Foundry or building AI demos/proofs of concept is a strong plus.
A relevant Microsoft certification (AZ-104, AZ-305, or AZ-400) is a plus.
Fluent in Dutch and English.
For senior candidates: experience leading architecture decisions on client-facing engagements and mentoring other engineers.

What do we offer?

Competitive salary package, including annual salary increase, bonuses, and NS Business Card.
Tailored training and development opportunities to position you as an expert in your field.
Flexible working arrangements (office, home, client sites) and international project exposure.
Collaborative global environment fostering professional growth and knowledge sharing.

Additional information

Unfortunately, we are unable to provide a work permit for this position.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering
jobs.description:
Head of Engineering bij Budget Thuis

Kandidaatprofiel

Over 7 years of experience in engineering leadership, building and scaling high-performing teams
Able to translate company vision and OKRs into technical direction and consistent delivery
Hands-on expertise in CI/CD, DORA metrics, cloud, and security-by-design
Experience working within a product operating model, linking engineering to customer and business value
Skilled in driving transformation, reducing technical debt, and modernizing platforms and processes
Strong communicator, fostering alignment and trust with Product, Business, and C-level stakeholders
Track record of managing and coaching managers

Budget Thuis makes essential household services simple and affordable, and that formula has fueled years of fast growth. Technology plays an ever bigger part in that story, from a new product operating model to major investments in AI. In close partnership with the CTO, the Head of Engineering sets the technical strategy that drives the next phase.

Over Budget Thuis

Gas, electricity, internet, and TV need to be available, reliable, and affordable, without complications. Budget Thuis is the only provider in the Netherlands that brings all these telecom and energy services under one roof. Its no-nonsense approach resonates: households switch to Budget Thuis for the convenience of one provider and the savings that come with it. Based in central Amsterdam, nearly 450 team members operate in an informal yet driven environment, blending a hands-on mindset with a strong focus on results. Together, they deliver exceptional service while fostering a culture of continuous improvement.

Commercially and operationally, Budget Thuis has built a strong position. Its TV proposition has launched, and by the end of this year its own fiber network will reach 2.4 million households. Rapid expansion and a series of acquisitions have also added complexity to the organization and its systems, opening up room to simplify and scale.

To support further expansion, the company has moved from a project-driven organization to a product operating model. Multidisciplinary teams take end-to-end ownership of processes and the customer experience, coordinated through OKRs, with product, engineering, and the business as equal voices at the table. The new structure is in place and has strong backing from the executive board and the CTO. Now the focus shifts to embedding the new way of working throughout engineering.

“We've laid the foundation for a product engineering culture, now we need a leader who can turn that into consistent execution, at scale, across every team.” - Noureddine Abdelaziz CTO

Vacature Head of Engineering

With ambitious growth goals ahead, the Head of Engineering shapes the technology roadmap and develops a high-performing engineering function that aligns closely with product goals and architectural priorities. The target way of working is clear: trunk-based development with short-lived branches, and automated testing instead of manual QA, with CI/CD and DORA metrics as the backbone. The stack runs on .NET, in a hybrid setup of on-premises infrastructure and Azure.

Leading six Engineering Managers and 92 engineers across seven domains, including a recently added data platform team, the Head of Engineering sets the bar for delivery and technical quality. The markets behind these domains differ widely: internet and TV call for a different approach than mobile or energy. Building a strong management layer to delegate to with confidence is an important part of the job. So is shaping how teams develop and the frameworks they work within, with collaboration and ownership as the norm. Reporting directly to the CTO and part of the CTO’s management team, the Head of Engineering works closely with the Head of Product, forming a leadership duo that connects product and engineering. Collaboration with peers in design, architecture, business, and operations further strengthens this integrated approach.

The timing makes this an attractive moment to join. The heavy lifting of the restructuring is done. What lies ahead is the part where engineering leadership makes the difference. That means completing the transformation, so Budget Thuis can respond faster to what customers need. It also means putting the modernization strategy for the legacy applications into practice. The rollout of AI within engineering is in this leader's hands, with plenty of room to operate. The foundation is already there: a company-wide Centre of Excellence led by the CTO and an in-house GPU server running open-source models. The key choices on automation and AI agents are being made now.

Success in this role rests on technical depth and a genuine enjoyment of people management. That combination ideally grows from a career that started in software engineering and moved step by step into leadership. It gives the credibility to challenge and coach engineers, while the Engineering Managers run day-to-day execution. Experience leading a transformation in a larger organization is essential, as systems thinking here applies to culture and behavior as much as to technology. Microservices, cloud-native technologies, and developer experience are familiar territory. A leader eager to make a lasting impact will find a natural fit here.

Interesse?

jobs.title: Senior Dynamics F&O Engineer
jobs.description:
Job Description

This is Allego

Allego is the leading company for fast and ultra-fast charging solutions to companies and consumers throughout Europe. We build and operate our public charging network ranging from regular charging to state-of-the-art high-power charging that can be used by all electric cars, providing a seamless charging experience. Our goal is to contribute to zero-emission mobility and allow EV drivers to charge at the right place with the right speed.

The EV market is emerging and changing rapidly. With our proven track record and long experience, we keep driving forward with confidence.

About The Role

As a Senior Dynamics 365 Engineer, you will play a key role in strengthening our Dynamics landscape across F&O, CE, and the Power Platform. You’ll work within a skilled internal engineering team supporting the technology behind Allego’s European charging infrastructure operations.

In this role, you will design, build, and improve solutions across our full Dynamics stack - from X++ development in F&O to Power Apps and integrations using Azure services. You will collaborate closely with functional consultants, architects, and internal business stakeholders to build reliable, scalable, and future-ready systems.

We are looking for someone who enjoys working across multiple Dynamics areas, is comfortable in a modern engineering environment, and is eager to help us further adopt the Power Platform and Azure technologies.

What You Will Do

Develop, extend, and optimise functionality in Dynamics 365 F&O and Dynamics 365 CE
Build solutions using Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse)
Design and implement integrations using Azure Logic Apps, REST APIs, OData, DMF, and Azure API Management
Participate in solution design, code reviews, and technical architecture discussions
Work with Azure DevOps to manage work items, repositories, branching, and CI/CD pipelines
Ensure best practices in the D365 extension model, code quality, performance, and maintainability
Support continuous improvement of our development approach (e.g., automated testing, RSAT/ATL, LCS environment management)
Work closely with functional consultants and internal customers to analyse requirements and translate them into clean, scalable solutions
Break down work into deliverables and provide accurate time estimates

Job Requirements

What You Bring

5+ years professional development experience with Dynamics 365 F&O / X++.
Strong experience with Power Platform (PowerApps, Power Automate, Dataverse).
Experience with Azure DevOps, Git repositories, and CI/CD.
Solid understanding of integrations, including REST APIs, OData, DMF, and Logic Apps.
Nice to have experience with Dynamics 365 CE / CRM development.
Comfortable working in an Agile environment and collaborating in hybrid teams.
Ability to communicate clearly with internal customers and colleagues.
You are fluent in English.
You are able to visit our office in Arnhem.

Our Offer

This role allows you to work within a team of specialists contributing directly to the technology powering European EV charging. You will be at the forefront of modern charging and mobility solutions.

We offer a competitive salary package with strong secondary conditions, including:

End-of-year premium
Personal budget
A solid pension scheme
Opportunities for professional training and certifications
Hybrid working: a healthy balance between our Arnhem office and working from home

You’ll join colleagues who are motivated to make a real impact and who believe that working together is the key to driving zero-emission mobility forward. Expect a challenging role in a fast-paced, ambitious environment where you can grow, innovate, and help shape our Dynamics landscape.
